mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 5.0% (UNRATE) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 500) and retail sales (RSAFS > 380000) signals robust consumer demand, increasing corporate revenue visibility and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 500 and RSAFS > 380000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), higher policy rates increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings expansion and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 90 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts below 500 thousand units (HOUST < 500) signals weakening residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 500 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) and stagnant monetary policy (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%) indicates unaddressed inflationary pressures, triggering stagflation risks and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP level below 13,000 billion dollars (GDPC1 < 13000) reflects economic contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 13000 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
